semantic_scope: NEURON nrnivmodl translates greeting.mod, compiles C++ and links libnrnmech.so. nrniv automatically loads the mechanism library; check.hoc creates soma, inserts greeting and calls finitialize(-65), which executes the NMODL INITIAL block and prints exactly one Hello, World! line.
